disclaimer: This file is data, not investment advice. It contains no recommendation to buy or sell anything.
whatThisIs: Workforce figures that Korean listed companies file with the Financial Supervisory Service, joined to KRX daily prices. 2879 companies.
whatThisIsNot: Not a claim about discrimination. We publish ratios; the reasons are not in the filings.
Not a benchmark. No company is scored, ranked as good, or compared to a norm.
Not total payroll. Pay columns are annual pay PER PERSON in Korean won.
Not a complete market. A company appears only if it filed workforce figures.
source: DART (Financial Supervisory Service) employee status filings; KRX daily trading data
withheldRule: A women-to-men ratio is left blank when either sex has fewer than 5 employees, when a figure was not reported, or when the denominator is zero. The reason is given in pay_ratio_withheld_reason.

columns.name_en: English company name as filed with DART.
columns.market: KOSPI or KOSDAQ, from KRX. Blank when the ticker did not trade on the price date.
columns.sector_ko: Industry name as recorded by DART. Korean text; an English mapping is not yet published.
columns.fiscal_year: Filing year of the workforce figures.
columns.women_share: women divided by headcount. Blank when either is missing.
columns.tenure_years: Average years of service, all employees.
columns.tenure_ratio_women_to_men: tenure_years_women divided by tenure_years_men. Withheld on thin cells.
columns.annual_pay_per_person_krw_men: Annual pay PER PERSON for men, Korean won.
columns.annual_pay_per_person_krw_women: Annual pay PER PERSON for women, Korean won.
columns.pay_ratio_women_to_men: Women pay divided by men pay. 1.0 means equal. Withheld on thin cells.
columns.pay_ratio_withheld_reason: Why a ratio is blank. Empty when a ratio is given.
columns.price_as_of: Trading date of the price columns. Blank when no price was joined.
